translations.web: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.
translations.bsb: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
translations.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
translations.asv: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.
